file_id: Pralayraj Mukherjee & Anr vs Unknown on 12 September, 2018

sentences.text: Pralayraj Mukherjee & Anr vs Unknown on 12 September, 2018

Author: Shivakant Prasad
Bench: Shivakant Prasad
 1
 C.R.R. 1499 Of 2004
2.09.18
.

In the matter of : Pralayraj Mukherjee & Anr.
Mr. Aslam Khan Mr. Subhankar Mahata ... For the Petitioners.

The petitioner Praayraj Mukherjee who has assailed the judgement of conviction and sentence under Section 16(1)(a)(i) read with Section 7 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 passed in Crim9nal Appeal No 70 of 1998 by the 13th Bench of City Sessions Court at Calcutta, is now reported dead as per the duplicate death certificate filed this day by Learned Advocate for the petitioner.

entities.text: 13th Bench of City Sessions Court at Calcutta
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In view thereof this revisional application is dismissed.
Let the death certificate be kept on the record.
Urgent Photostat certificate copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the petitioner, as expeditiously as possible.

(Shivakant Prasad, J.)
